caseName: Anderson v. New York Life Insurance
caseNameFull: Charles W. Anderson, Collector of Internal Revenue v. New York Life Insurance Company

opinions.text: Order granting writ, of certiorari herein set aside to enable a *687resubmission of the petition after due notice to counsel for the respondent. The Solicitor General for petitioner. Mr. James H. McIntosh for respondent. . [See 255 U. S. 568; also, post, 696.]
